Name: Neon Signs
Author: undare
Description:
[size=3]An [b]add-on [/b]mod for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9346]Organic Lamps [/url] <--([color=#ffe599][b]Required[/b][/color])
Want more lamps?
-[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10045]Mineral Lamps[/url]  add-on
Want to start decorating faster?
-[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13204]Catalogues are Cheap[/url]



To craft each of the new lamps, you will only need 
-[color=#d5a6bd][b]1 Refined Quartz[/b][/color]

Colors include :
[b]-[color=#dd7e6b]Red (Apples)[/color]
-[color=#f6b26b]Orange (Fire)[/color]
-[color=#ffe599]Yellow (Sun)[/color]
-White (Stars)
-[color=#b6d7a8]Green (Leaves)[/color]
-[color=#6fa8dc]Blue (Moon)[/color]
-[color=#d5a6bd]Violet (Hearts)[/color][/b]


The new crafting station is located in [color=#e69138][b]Robin[/b][/color]´s lamp workshop at the upper top left corner (Black desk with neon lights)

They all can be powered with a [color=#ffe599]Sap [/color]unit.[/size]

Downloads.Description:
FIrst release
-7 Colored neon signs
-English/Spanish support
